Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one accessible ordinary mechanism. Learn the mechanism's ordinary materials, intended function and one accessible component whose removal or adjustment would disable it. Choose a component suitable for reuse in a known compatible recipe, if one is present. You or an ally gains 2 Boons to the next attribute roll this scene repairing or disabling the mechanism, or crafting with that component.
